title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return `false` if every element is distinct.

hints.content: A set stores only unique values.
Compare the size of the set with the length of the array, or check set.has() during iteration.
new Set(nums).size !== nums.length provides a clean one-liner.

solution.explanation:
A Set removes duplicates. If the set size is smaller than the array length, duplicates exist.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
